description: SEC enforcement actions by type: litigation releases (civil actions filed in federal court), administrative proceedings (in-house actions before an ALJ or the Commission), or trading suspensions. Answers 'recent SEC litigation releases', 'SEC administrative proceedings', 'what trading suspensions has the SEC issued'. The distinction matters — an administrative proceeding is not a federal-court lawsuit. Returns dated items with links. Covers only the current feed window (about 25 items per type), not history.

type.description: Which SEC action type to return (default litigation).
